decisions.statement: Running this file calls the default export the file declares.
The command reads the arguments and writes the answer.
A function the command calls reads no argument and writes no answer.
A revive whose io did not advance is a verdict to the caller and exit three from the command.
A gated restart clears when the restart is armed rather than when a supervisor is up.
The pane is held open before the takeover.
A takeover ends the supervisor process the pane runs.
A seat with a session is respawned in place so its attached terminals are kept.
A seat with no session is killed and launched again.
A launch flag handed to a live seat is refused rather than quietly ignored.
The seat this process sits in is read from its own environment where the caller states no seat.
A name matching no seat brings that seat's page back before the name is read.
A name nothing brings back is refused as the resolver refused it.
What a resume is asked for is stated as values rather than spelled as a command line.

definition: a seat put back on the session it was bound to, live or stopped
